name: Honda VFR800 Interceptor
engine: 781 cc liquid-cooled V4, gear-driven cams (1998-2001) or VTEC (2002 on), fuel injected
intro: Honda's V4 sport tourer. Regulator/rectifier failures and cam chain tensioners on VTEC bikes are the known issues.

add.title: Check the regulator/rectifier and stator plug
add.instructions: Measure battery voltage at idle and at 5,000 rpm. Look for a melted or brown stator connector and a scorched regulator. Clean and solder the connections if needed.
add.reason: Hot connectors and a failing regulator are a common way these bikes stop charging.

add.title: Listen for cam chain rattle
add.instructions: On a cold start, listen for a rattle in the first 30 seconds. On 2002 and later VTEC bikes, the front tensioner is the usual culprit.
add.reason: Worn tensioners let the cam chain slap.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Regulator/rectifier
known.what: Premature regulator/rectifier failure is the most common VFR800 complaint.
